items.name: RAnimEngine::DeactivateSystem
items.plate_exact: INVENTED NAME, not canonical: this helper is absent from the debug-symbol spreadsheet (a static; the PS2 twin is FUN_001a1af8 at 0x001a1af8, which the sheet's RAnimEngine::Update size swallows). Named for what it does: deactivates one animation system - clears its active flag, and if asked processes its pending stimulus and shifts the 4-slot stimulus queue, then decrements the active-system count. Called by RAnimEngine::System::Update (0x77ed0). Was RAnimEngine::Shutdown from a Version Tracking match; the real Shutdown only zeroes the count.
